questions.q: In soccer, what is a game called when one team plays its rival from the same city?
questions.fact: The Manchester derby is between Manchester United and Manchester City.

questions.q: What is the Spanish name for the big rivalry match between Real Madrid and FC Barcelona?
questions.fact: El Clásico is one of the most watched club soccer matches in the world.

questions.q: In which sport do gymnasts perform a vault called the Yurchenko?
questions.fact: The Yurchenko vault is named after Soviet gymnast Natalia Yurchenko.
